item.title: TLA+ vs Apalache vs CBMC in 2026: Which Model Checker Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Some bugs are invisible to every test you will ever write. A distributed lock that passes code review can still lose a message under one interleaving in ten million, and no amount of unit testing explores the schedules your production cluster will invent at 3 a.m. Model checkers exist to attack exactly that class of bug — by enumerating the behaviours your design allows instead of sampling a handful of them.
